title: An untracked part with no bins gets a default bin row when tracking is turned on
custom_preconds:
• An untracked part created through the API with "bins":[] (no bin at all).
  • Parts > Inventory, search the part.
custom_steps:
1. Open the part.
  2. Switch Track quantities and cost of goods ON.
  3. Click Save.
custom_expected:
Step 1:

  • The Inventory section has no bin rows, only + Add Bin Location.

Step 2:

  • Min and Max show; a default-bin row appears (General Storage) with Quantity 0 and the Default badge.

Step 3:

  • Saves with no error; the row shows {bin} 0 and "0 available".
